title: She Works, He Works: A Curious Exploration of Gender Bias in AI-Generated Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2407.18524v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: She Works, He Works is an interdisciplinary project that combines feminist visual theory, AI critique, and artistic practice to examine gender representation in AI-generated imagery. By juxtaposing text-to-image outputs of male and female construction workers, it reveals how societal biases manifest in generative AI systems. The study employs critically crafted prompts that blend traditionally gendered traits with unconventional contexts, exposing disparities in representation-emphasizing aesthetics and agility for women versus authority and professionalism for men. Grounded in Griselda Pollock's feminist insights on visual culture, the project positions AI as both a technological and cultural actor, capable of perpetuating stereotypes and enabling critique. translated_title: 她在工作，他在工作：对AI生成图像中性别偏见的探索性研究
translated_abstract: “她工作，他工作”是一个跨学科项目，结合了女性主义视觉理论、AI批判与艺术实践，以审视AI生成图像中的性别表征。通过将男性和女性建筑工人的文生图输出并置对比，该项目揭示了社会偏见如何在生成式AI系统中显现。研究采用了经过批判性设计的提示词，将传统性别特征与非传统语境相结合，暴露出表征中的差异——对女性的刻画强调美感与灵巧，而对男性则强调权威与专业性。该项目立足于格里塞尔达·波洛克（Griselda Pollock）对视觉文化的女性主义洞见，将AI定位为兼具技术与文化属性的行为者，既能够延续刻板印象，也能够促成批判。作为一个兼具研究与艺术作品双重性质的项目，它强调了AI在重塑性别规范和激发公平叙事方面的变革潜力。它突出了伦理……
tldr: 该研究通过并置对比男性和女性建筑工人的AI生成图像，揭示了生成式AI系统中女性被强调美感、男性被强调权威的性别偏见，同时展现了AI作为批判工具重塑性别规范的变革潜力。
en_tdlr: This interdisciplinary project juxtaposes AI-generated images of male and female construction workers to expose gender biases in generative AI—emphasizing aesthetics for women versus authority for men—while highlighting AI's transformative potential to reimagine gender norms and inspire equitable narratives.
